tile_scope: Pilot of tile-size sensitivity, not full-volume repair or paper parity. Tile extent also changes PolicyPeaks context and seed order. Score each region separately: overlapping contexts are not independent replicates. Require every tile complete before paired scores. No GT-based merging.

gate_result.scope: Same completed single-checkpoint resegmentation scores and single-pass FFN base. Different published gate only; not the three-checkpoint PATHFINDER baseline.
gate_result.policy: Global union from complete full-context candidate scores, remapped onto retained globally decoded core; no core-local merging. Core ancestry relies on preserved export and previously accepted comparison, not a restored full array.

conclusion: Tile extent materially affects both pilot regions, including increased merges; paper gate alone does not improve validation nERL. Neither experiment establishes paper parity. Six-run consensus remains pending.
